lore: Once a year the storm season rolls over DiskSaver Island, and every save the islands have ever written has to come through it. Archivist Maren hands the keeper the season's ledger: seven storms, seven stations, and every save on the island assigned to the storm that will test it. Get a station wrong and that storm takes its share of the archive. When the last storm blows out, Maren counts what survived and seals the ledger, and the seal is a chain of hashes, so nobody can quietly rewrite how a storm went.

acts.storm: Fog on the reefs: only the buoys say which reef is worth a dive.
An atoll sinks and a new one rises: move as few saves as you can.
Quays go dark one by one: no read may come back stale.
A bad write spreads: roll back from a shell without filling the beach.
Wreckage piles up: the gulls must clear the dead saves, cycles and all.
The ferry runs late: the pelicans must fly saves ahead of the reader.
Swells hit the harbour: the breakwater must hold without bloating.

lines.start: Seven storms this season. Every save on the island is written against one of them. Let's see how many we keep.
lines.act: Next station. Remember what the last storm taught you.
lines.audit: Storms are done. Ledger open, chain checked, every save counted.
lines.gold: Not one save lost. I'm sealing this ledger in gold.
lines.pass: We lost a station's share, but the archive stands. Sealed.
lines.fail: Too much went into the sea, or someone touched the ledger. I can't seal this.
